findings.issue: MediaRoom only shows generic 'Failed to connect to media server' on error with no distinction between permission-denied, network failure, or LiveKit unavailability
findings.impact: When browser blocks camera/mic, users see a vague error with no guidance to check browser permissions.
findings.fix: Catch getUserMedia errors specifically: check for NotAllowedError and show contextual message with link to browser permission settings.

findings.issue: Dev remote compose omits LIVEKIT_HOST env var on API container, breaking LiveKit token generation in development
findings.impact: Developers testing media features locally must manually add LIVEKIT_HOST to .env because devremote compose does not pass it.
findings.fix: Add LIVEKIT_HOST: http://livekit:7880 to API environment in docker-compose.devremote.yml.

findings.issue: MediaRoom uses ControlBar variation='minimal' which hides screen share and other advanced controls
findings.impact: Users cannot share their screen during calls unless the minimal variant exposes it.
findings.fix: Add a dedicated screen-share toggle button outside ControlBar, or switch to variation='full'.

findings.issue: No keyboard shortcut support for media controls — mute/unmute (M), video toggle (V), screen share (S), leave call (Esc)
findings.impact: Users cannot quickly mute/unmute or toggle video during calls via keyboard, which is standard in all major video conferencing tools.
findings.fix: Add global keydown event listeners in MediaRoom for M (mute), V (toggle video), S (screen share), Esc (minimize/leave).
